rationale: The assistant followed a sensible, safe path: clean the latch hooks/slots first, then check door alignment and closing firmness, and it correctly used the customer's clues (grease, slight door sag, more stops when closed gently) to point at the door interlock/latch. It explicitly said 'Please do not open the casing yourself' and escalated to Bosch Service once the customer said they'd pay for a visit, with no part purchase pushed. Calibration is the weak point: the headings 'Failing door interlock microswitch' read more certain than the evidence allows and the possibility of an intermittent control module fault was never acknowledged, though the body text hedged with 'likely' and 'either'.
